data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin to fetch required headers for calling Google APIs with an app-restricted API key.
data.what_it_does: It retrieves the required key and value pairs needed to call Google APIs based on the platform (iOS or Android) when using an app-restricted API key.
use_when: You need to call Google APIs from your app using an app-restricted API key.
You need platform-specific headers automatically generated for Google API requests.
avoid_when: You are not using Google APIs.
Your API keys do not have app restrictions.
strengths: Simplifies getting platform-specific headers for Google API requests.
Easy to integrate with a single asynchronous method call.
weaknesses: Limited to getting Google API headers for app-restricted keys.
Platform-specific functionality heavily tied to iOS and Android environments.
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and call the API.
